primary.title: Gold, silver rates today: Comex gold drops $81/oz; silver tumbles $3 as traders weigh US-Iran deal prospects
primary.summary: Precious metals saw modest losses on May 27 amid ongoing Middle East conflict, with gold falling to $4,421 and silver down to $73.72. Concerns over inflation and interest rates persist, while US strikes on Iran raise doubts about a potential peace deal.
